lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Fancy Dress Party.
lines.zh: 化装舞会。

lines.en: Peppa and George are having a fancy dress party. All their friends are invited. Peppa is dressed as a fairy princess, and George is dressed as a dinosaur.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治要举办一场化装舞会。他们所有的朋友都受到了邀请。佩奇打扮成仙女公主，乔治打扮成恐龙。

lines.en: Dinosaur!
lines.zh: 恐龙！

lines.en: Here are Peppa's friends: Candy Cat, Suzy Sheep, Danny Dog, Rebecca Rabbit and Pedro Pony. Suzy is wearing her nurse's costume.
lines.zh: 佩奇的朋友们来了：小猫坎迪、小羊苏西、小狗丹尼、小兔瑞贝卡和小马佩德罗。苏西穿着她的护士服。

lines.en: Hello, Suzy. Hello, Mr. Pig. I'm glad the nurse has arrived. Have you just come from the hospital? Uh, I'm not a real nurse, it's just pretend.
lines.zh: 你好，苏西。你好，猪先生。很高兴护士来了。你是刚从医院过来吗？呃，我不是真的护士，只是假装的。

lines.en: Very good. My, my, who have we here? I'm a pirate! Shiver me timbers!
lines.zh: 非常好。哎呀，我们这儿还有谁呀？我是海盗！嘿哟嘿哟！

lines.en: I'm a witch, I can turn you into a frog!
lines.zh: 我是女巫，我可以把你变成青蛙！

lines.en: No! I'm a clown!
lines.zh: 不对！我是小丑！

lines.en: That's funny! What are you, Rebecca Rabbit? I'm a carrot!
lines.zh: 真有趣！瑞贝卡，你扮的是什么？我是一根胡萝卜！

lines.en: Fantastic! Come in, there's a fairy princess and a dinosaur waiting to meet you.
lines.zh: 太棒了！进来吧，有一位仙女公主和一只恐龙正等着见你们呢。

lines.en: Hello, everyone! Hello! Hello!
lines.zh: 大家好！你好！你好！

lines.en: Hello, I'm Princess Peppa.
lines.zh: 你好，我是佩奇公主。

lines.en: You must bow when you speak to me. Hello, Your Majesty. Hmm... I'm Nurse Susie. Open wide and say ah.
lines.zh: 你跟我说话的时候必须鞠躬。你好，公主殿下。嗯……我是护士苏西。张大嘴说「啊」。

lines.en: I'm a clown! Do something funny!
lines.zh: 我是小丑！表演点好笑的！

lines.en: Rebecca, why are you dressed as a carrot? I like carrots!
lines.zh: 瑞贝卡，你为什么扮成胡萝卜呀？因为我喜欢胡萝卜！

lines.en: Dinosaur! A scary dinosaur!
lines.zh: 恐龙！一只吓人的恐龙！

lines.en: Peppa is admiring herself in the mirror. Mirror, mirror on the wall, who's the fairest of them all? You are, Peppa!
lines.zh: 佩奇在照镜子欣赏自己。魔镜魔镜告诉我，谁是世界上最美丽的人？是你，佩奇！

lines.en: Meow! Hello, Peppa. Hello, I'm little Fairy Princess.
lines.zh: 喵！你好，佩奇。你好，我是小仙女公主。

lines.en: I'm a witch... meow! And I've got a magic wand. I've got a magic one, too! I can turn you into a frog! And I'll turn you into a frog!
lines.zh: 我是女巫……喵！我有一根魔法棒。我也有一根！我可以把你变成青蛙！那我就把你变成青蛙！

lines.en: Dinosaur!
lines.zh: 恐龙！

lines.en: Oh, dear, George is scared of his own reflection. Oh, silly George, look, it's you in the mirror!
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，乔治被自己的倒影吓到了。哦，傻乔治，你看，镜子里那就是你自己呀！

lines.en: Children, it's time to decide who has the best fancy dress costume. We need a judge.
lines.zh: 孩子们，现在该选出谁的化装服最棒了。我们需要一位评委。

lines.en: As it's Peppa's party, maybe she should be the judge. I'm the judge! I'm the judge! Daddy, what is a judge? The judge decides who has the best costume. Oh, goody!
lines.zh: 既然这是佩奇的派对，也许该由她来当评委。我是评委！我是评委！爸爸，评委是什么？评委决定谁的服装最好。哦，太好啦！

lines.en: Peppa is going to choose who has the best costume. Suzy, can I see your costume, please? Hmm.
lines.zh: 佩奇要来选出谁的服装最好。苏西，能让我看看你的服装吗？嗯。

lines.en: I'm Nurse Susie, I make people better. Very good, Nurse Susie!
lines.zh: 我是护士苏西，我能让病人好起来。非常好，护士苏西！

lines.en: Now, Danny. I'm a pirate! Shiver me timbers!
lines.zh: 现在轮到丹尼。我是海盗！嘿哟嘿哟！

lines.en: Now, Candy. Meow! I'm a witch, I can turn you into a frog! Well, I'm a fairy princess, and I can turn you into a frog!
lines.zh: 现在轮到坎迪。喵！我是女巫，我可以把你变成青蛙！哼，我是仙女公主，我也能把你变成青蛙！

lines.en: Children, children! Sorry, Mummy. Who's next? I'm a clown!
lines.zh: 孩子们，孩子们！对不起，妈妈。下一个是谁？我是小丑！

lines.en: That's funny!
lines.zh: 真有趣！

lines.en: Rebecca? I'm a carrot! Lovely!
lines.zh: 瑞贝卡呢？我是一根胡萝卜！真可爱！

lines.en: And my little brother George is a scary dinosaur! Grr!
lines.zh: 还有我的弟弟乔治是一只吓人的恐龙！吼！

lines.en: Everyone's costume is very good.
lines.zh: 每个人的服装都非常好。

lines.en: Now you say who the winner is. Oh, yes. Um... and the winner is me!
lines.zh: 现在你来宣布谁是冠军。哦，对。嗯……冠军就是我！

lines.en: Peppa, you can't pick yourself, you're the judge! Oh, can't I? You have to pick another winner. Okay, the carrot wins! Hooray!
lines.zh: 佩奇，你不能选你自己，你是评委呀！哦，不能吗？你得选别的冠军。好吧，胡萝卜赢了！太好啦！

lines.en: Thank you. Peppa loves fancy dress parties.
lines.zh: 谢谢。佩奇喜欢化装舞会。

lines.en: Everyone loves fancy dress parties!
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢化装舞会！
